question: Which hex6 definition is most robust to detection errors on the existing stride-8 maps? One variant is chosen here, a priori for the stride-2 confirmation.
variants: A Voronoi sides, complete cells (p2 hex6)
evaluation: LOFO blend vs HEX as in p2; selection on these rows is acknowledged; the confirmation on sg2 peaks uses the chosen variant only
decision: chosen = most negative HEX delta; it is carried into sg2_blend as the confirmation feature
